Day 4 is a Wednesday (the Seongsu candidate would be open). Verify the exact intended venue and re-check hours before going.

rows.name: Ikseon Chwihyang / "Favorite of Ikseon"
rows.claim: Itinerary lists it TWICE: "Chwihyang — pork belly rose pasta $14.50" and "Favorite of Ikseon — try the pork belly rose pasta $14.50"
rows.notes: IMPORTANT: 'Chwihyang' and 'Favorite of Ikseon' are the SAME restaurant — 익선취향's English name is 'Favorite of Ikseon' (Instagram @favorite_ikseon). The Day 6 list duplicates it. TikTok-famous for the whole pork-belly rosé pasta (통삼겹 로제파스타, currently ₩18,900 ≈ $14 on Korean menu listings — matches the itinerary's $14.50). Reported hours: daily 12:00-21:00, queues from ~12:10, min 1 main per person, CatchTable reservations advised. No official website — hours/price from consistent third-party listings, flagged. Also on the menu: omurice, steak, curry risotto.
rows.transit: Jongno 3-ga Station (Lines 1/3/5) Exit 4, ~5 min walk into the alleys.

rows.transit: Eastern Seoul (Seongnae-dong, Gangdong-gu) — roughly 45-60 min from Ikseon-dong by transit; check a map app for the exact route.
